title: Destroyed Nations, Desire as a God, and Allah's Signs

paragraphs.text: Whenever the disbelievers bring an argument, Allah gives the Prophet the truth and the best explanation. Those dragged on their faces to Hell are in the worst place and the farthest from the right way.

Allah gave Moses the Scripture and made his brother Aaron his helper. Those who denied His signs were completely destroyed. The people of Noah denied the messengers, so Allah drowned them and made them a sign for mankind. 'Aad, Thamud, the people of the well, and many generations between them were also destroyed. The disbelievers have passed by the town that received a rain of evil. Yet they do not expect to be raised again.

When they see the Prophet, they mock him. They say he almost turned them away from their gods. When they see the punishment, they will know who was truly lost. Have you seen the one who takes his own desire as his god? Most of them are like cattle, or even more lost.

Look at how your Lord stretches out the shadow. If He willed, He could make it stay still. He made the sun a guide for it, then He draws it back slowly. He made the night like a covering, sleep for rest, and the day for rising. He sends the winds as good news before His mercy. He sends pure water from the sky to bring dead land to life. It gives drink to animals and people.

hardWords.m: a dark shape made when something blocks light
